text:
Maya: quick sync on Trace Viewer UX - focus areas: filter strip density, export label clarity, and stacktrace correlation affordances. posted compact mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123

Ben: nice work. main concern is visual noise when many filter chips wrap and push the timeline. suggestion: keep correlation and request-id pinned, collapse the rest into a single 'Filters (N)' expander that opens inline.

Priya: +1 to pinned ids. also we should make export wording explicit. engineers expect precise scope. propose: 'Export filtered sessions (CSV)'. put it in the kebab and show a small inline quick-export when filters > 0.

Noah: accessibility: make the chip group a single tab stop and implement roving tabindex inside. chips should have aria-pressed and labels like 'Filter: correlation id equals 0a1b2c' so screen readers hear type + value. announce filter count changes with aria-live=polite.

Ivy: copy nit: when a chip opens its menu, the copy-to-clipboard action should say 'Copy trace link with correlation id'. also the export modal needs aria-describedby summarizing count + active filters for SR users.

Ben: behavior note: the '+N' expander should show hidden filters with checkboxes and actions (remove, copy link). keep copy action adding ?corr=0a1b2c to the link. mobile opens as bottom sheet. add subtle animation so layout doesn't feel jumpy.

Priya: confirm backend shape: export endpoint should accept filters: [ {type, op, value} ] and include_correlation: true|false. Noah can we validate that with API team?

Noah: i'll check and report back. quick add: add a tiny pill next to stacktrace timestamps when a correlation id exists — helps scanning in long traces. low lift, high value.

design-bot: snapshot created: figma frame 'trace-viewer/filter-strip/compact-a11y' (v1).

Maya: next steps: Ben to update mock with expander + roving tabindex; Ivy to draft exact SR copy strings; Noah to confirm API fields; Priya to finalize export CTA placement. i'll collect updates and open a copy PR. thanks! :thumbsup:
